resolver_weapons.special_trait: Silent lethal headshots using high-velocity saw blades and CDs

resolver_weapons.obtained_from: Purchased from Juan with Depleted Uranium

unique_weapons.name: The Autocrat
unique_weapons.coordinates: Underground armory behind wooden mesh barrier

unique_weapons.name: La Varita
mods: Shoots through walls when paired with Triador Supremo

supremos.name: Exterminador
supremos.ability: Armageddon Strike (fires a barrage of homing rockets)
supremos.acquisition: Starter Supremo provided by Juan Cortez

supremos.name: Triador
supremos.ability: Truesight (marks enemies through solid cover; pairs with La Varita)
supremos.acquisition: Oluwa Cave chest upon returning all 3 Triada Relics

supremos.name: Furioso
supremos.ability: Thrust boost dodge leaving an incendiary ring behind Dani

relics.solution: Scale cliffs using grapple swings and ziplines across cavern shafts.
relics.reward: Ida's Sigil gear piece + Ida's Relic

relics.type: Treasure Hunt: And the Beat Goes On / Oku's Idol
relics.solution: Visit estate at night. Press piano button, push switch behind mirror, press room switches in sequence, and retrieve key to enter the well.
relics.reward: Oku's Deliverance gear piece + Oku's Relic

relics.type: Treasure Hunt: Mimo Abosi's Triada Relic
relics.solution: Grab keycard from dead worker, shoot out electrical generator lock, turn off flooded generator switch, dive through flooded tunnel to the shaft.
relics.reward: Mimo Abosi's Mirage gear piece + Mimo Abosi's Relic

key_operations.objective: Escape the military curfew through the sewers with Lita.

key_operations.title: The Lucky One
key_operations.objective: Wake up on the beach of Isla Santuario and rendezvous with Clara Garcia.

key_operations.title: Libertad Rises
key_operations.objective: Assault the offshore naval blockades and escape to the Zamok Archipelago.
